title: Presales Design Support Architect - Service Management & Orchestration
description:
Orange Business is here!

About us

Orange Business is a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business. Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

About the role

The Presales Solution Design Support team being an integral part of the IPSE will interlock with Global Marketing, GDO, CDIO and International teams with a clear objective of streamlining the bid process, accelerate presales autonomy, simplify presales solution development and validation, and increase our win ratio. The team will continuously develop their skills in strategic domains as well as technical skills for the future to drive value to our customers. That’s why the 3 main strategy pillars for IPSE are based on;

  • Replicability through Capitalization: facilitate replicability using capitalization to optimize what has been already sold. Identify reusable solutions and ensure capitalization of repetitive proposed solutions to expand presales autonomy and support Product Management. More specifically, provide Brick and others documentation to accelerate sales autonomy
  • Improving Velocity of our solution design & validation, facilitate the Go to Market for more sales autonomy through early engagement by participating to qualification phase,
  • Bring add value expertise to the SVP, being aligned with the SVP strategy to support SVP and Innovative support integration

Job Description

The Presales Solution Design Architect will work within different squads as a pivotal link among all organizations and presales teams, committed to providing guidance, technical expertise and assistance to promote technically and commercially innovative solutions that matches customer needs.

He/She will guarantee simplified approaches leading to optimizations, facilitate new services integration and orchestration, increase the volume of available knowledge for replicability, and bring agility to the process.

Main activities

In their engagements the Presales Design Support Architect will navigate complexities and assist presales while;

  • Contributing actively to the international bid process providing support at different stages (consultancy via early engagement in qualification phase, guidance during design stage, validation and costing of non-standard elements, handover of won deals)
  • Being responsible for providing solution design expertise support to global presales teams with relevance to SVPs and domain of expertise.
  • Adopting new ways of working promoting agility and presales autonomy via replicability.
  • Engaging with Marketing and Business Development when appropriate to review strategy and solution positioning
  • Minimizing response times and ensure the quality of a solution in support of sales. Solutions are expected to be commercially competitive, while maintaining or exceeding the level of compliancy agreed within solution strategy.
  • Coordinating actions internally and externally to ensure all the solution components are implementable and operable from engineering, delivery (GDO & I2), operations, and IT standpoints.
  • Assessing associated risks of tailored solutions, providing recommendations for risks provisioning as feasible, and documenting those risks in internal risk register.
  • After the bid is signed, ensure a smooth transition of commitment and deliverables from Pre-Sales to Post-Sales and support pre-sales worldwide communities through active contribution

The Presales Design Support Architect will ensure high quality of the below deliverables;

  • Validation responses including High-Level-Design (HLD) describing how the solution can be built, and ensuring it’s interworking with existing technologies or other service blocks. The response shall be assigned a maturity level that indicates the level of autonomy for future reuse.
  • Current replicable solutions continuously enriched with design updates, new features, delivery experience and product position.
  • Jointly developed service definitions and product collaterals as part of engagements within squads and/or product team projects

The Presales Design Support Architect will keep up-to-date with emerging trends and technologies in relevant domains and provide recommendations for their adoption within orange business SVPs strategy

About you

Key Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

  • Customer, objectives and results driven
  • Solid technical skills and knowledge of relevant domain/ field of expertise inline with Evolution platform SVP (DI; Connectivity , Cloud , Security and Orchestration) .
  • Strong knowledge of Service Management and Service Integration solutions , ex: Observability , Service now .
  • Good knowledge of OB solutions, organization, tools and processes
  • Strong people networking, stakeholder management and presentation skills.
  • Experience in working with Sales, Product Managers or Factories (Engineering, Operations, Affiliates)
  • Knowledge of digital integration and API development to enable the integration of telecommunications infrastructure with other enterprise systems.
  • Autonomous and comfortable in unknown environments
  • Strong Synthetic skill
  • Leadership and matrix management
  • Changemaker by gathering knowledge and resources, proposals driver
  • Creative and innovative behavior
  • Influence, negotiation, and persuasion
  • Ability to work in a multi-cultural environment.

Qualifications, Education and Certifications

  • BSc degree in engineering or telecommunications science or equivalent
  • 10+ years of experience in telecommunications or IT industry
  • Vendor certifications in the relevant domain/ field of expertise inline with SVP.
  • High knowledge of agility and transformation management – Scrum, DevOps, SAFe certifications is a plus
  • English fluent (spoken, written)

Additional information

  • Global opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world
  • Flexible work environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working)
  • Professional development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities
  • Career growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange
  • Caring and daring culture: health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events
  • Reward programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards

Only your skills matter

Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

Enfermeiro(a) - Alemanha DEKRA - Expert Migration

Você é Bacharel em Enfermagem ou está no último semestre? Aproveite, essa pode ser sua oportunidade de ter uma carreira internacional.

O Expert Migration Brazil da DEKRA é um programa internacional que prepara enfermeiros para emigrar e trabalhar em hospitais, clínicas e lares para idosos na Alemanha. Junte-se aos mais de 3.500 enfermeiros que estão trabalhando na Alemanha e trilhe uma carreira de sucesso internacional.

COMO FUNCIONA O EXPERT MIGRATION BRAZIL
O Expert Migration Brazil oferece treinamentos a enfermeiros bacharelados para prepará-los ao reconhecimento da profissão na Alemanha.

DURANTE A PREPARAÇÃO VOCÊ CONTARÁ COM:
Com o Programa da DEKRA você conta com um treinamento no idioma alemão, a fim de obter a certificação de proficiência necessária para migração e trabalho na Alemanha. Neste treinamento você participa de aulas de alemão de 2ª a 6ª conduzidas por professores com formação na área de ensino de línguas estrangeiras e/ou experiência internacional, além de contar com atividades complementares, como aulas de reforço (plantão), treinamento para entrevistas e para certificação de idioma.

BENEFÍCIOS DO DEKRA EXPERT MIGRATION BRAZIL

Vantagens de participar:

  1. Oportunidades de carreira e crescimento profissional como enfermeiro na Alemanha;
  2. Trabalho em equipe com profissionais internacionais;
  3. Oportunidade de morar e trabalhar em um país com alto índice de qualidade de vida.

Benefícios oferecidos:
  1. Assistência no processo seletivo com empregadores alemães: preparação para entrevistas e elaboração de currículo;
  2. Possibilidade de contrato de trabalho como enfermeiro licenciado em organizações parceiras da DEKRA;
  3. Suporte na validação do diploma de enfermagem e emissão de licença profissional;
  4. Suporte no processo de emissão de visto para migração.

Requisitos para participar:
  1. Ser graduado ou estar cursando o último semestre de bacharel em Enfermagem (não é necessário experiência);
  2. Ter disponibilidade para participar das aulas de alemão;
  3. Possuir interesse em morar e trabalhar na Alemanha e vivenciar uma nova cultura;
  4. Ter até 42 anos no momento da candidatura.

Não é exigido ter o conhecimento de outros idiomas.


Aceitamos candidatura de todo o Brasil.
INSCREVA-SE AGORA! E não perca essa oportunidade.

Programa internacional, presente em 6 países, que prepara profissionais para emigrar e trabalhar na Alemanha de forma legal e segura. O Expert Migration prepara o profissional para exercer sua função de forma reconhecida na Alemanha.

Questrade Financial Group (QFG) of Companies is committed to helping our customers become much more financially successful and secure.

We’re looking for our next Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Marketing Platform Engineering. Could It Be You?

Seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Marketing Platform Engineering to lead our Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) initiatives within the Marketing automation area. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in marketing technologies, extensive experience with Adobe Experience Platform, and a proven track record of leading engineering teams to deliver scalable and innovative solutions.

What’s it like working as a Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Marketing Platform Engineering at Questrade?

Reporting to the Director, Production & Operations, Engineering you will play a key role in translating Questrade’s direction for the overall systems aligning the technology roadmap within the Marketing technology domain. In partnership with the Director, identify significant architectural patterns and understand the impact on teams, advocate for strategic technology investments and roadmap alignment with the broader IT Strategy. Manage Engineering squads, including overseeing dependencies and long-term goals. Projects can be large and complex; this role is focused on setting the direction for the overall systems aligning the technology roadmap within the Marketing technology domain.

Adobe Experience Platform is the centralized and connected data foundation that powers customer experience management across Adobe Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, and Adobe Target. This role will involve the scaling out of the platform to multiple Lines of Business (Customer Journeys) making long term decisions that will guide the rollout.

Drive the strategic vision and implementation of AEP solutions to enhance our digital marketing capabilities.

Oversee the design, development, and deployment of AEP components.

Ensure seamless integration of AEP with other marketing technologies and data sources.

Manage multiple engineering projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including platforms, marketing, data science, and IT support, to gather requirements and define project scope.

Ensure project plans are maintained with status reports and documentation.

Stay current with industry trends and advancements in marketing automation.

Identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement within the engineering team.

Ensure the scalability, performance, and security of AEP implementations.

Strong in Data Engineering and System Integration.

Experience in Content Management Systems (CMS) would be advantageous.

Partner with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into technical solutions.

Communicate project progress, challenges, and successes to senior management and other stakeholders.

Act as a subject matter expert for AEP, providing insights and recommendations to drive business growth.

Champion the implementation of IT policies across multiple teams, influencing the department's overall compliance landscape.

Oversee the development and optimization of department-wide processes, ensuring they incorporate evolving IT/Cyber governance best practices.

Strategic partner with governance teams, advocating for necessary policy updates and contributing to risk assessments.

So are YOU our next Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Marketing Platform Engineering ? You are, if you have…

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

8+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.

Extensive experience with Adobe Experience Platform and its components (Adobe Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, and Adobe Target).

Proven track record of managing and delivering complex engineering projects in the digital marketing space.

Strong understanding of financial services and digital marketing trends.

Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with cloud platforms/capabilities such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Familiarity with data privacy regulations and compliance in the financial services industry. Certification in Adobe Experience Platform or related technologies.

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

We are hiring a Channel Partners Account Manager to our Channel Partner team in São Paulo !
The Channel Partners’ team plays a crucial role in expanding the company’s market presence and growth through strategic partnerships.
Our mission is to develop, support, and optimize relationships with commercial partners, driving revenue growth and enhancing partner success. By leveraging a strong indirect sales model, we ensure that our partners have the necessary tools, knowledge, and strategies to thrive.
Collaboration, innovation, and a results-driven mindset are at the core of our approach, making the Channel Partners’ team a key contributor to the company’s overall success.

Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN) is home to nearly 23,000 colleagues who make up our talented, vibrant and diverse workforce.

Be part of an exceptional health care experience. Join the inspired, passionate team at Lehigh Valley Health Network, a nationally recognized, forward-thinking organization offering plenty of opportunity to do great work.

LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. Finally, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Cedar Crest, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Muhlenberg, Lehigh Valley Hospital- Hazleton, and Lehigh Valley Hospital - Pocono each received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, the highest grade in patient safety. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.

Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.

Summary
Provides professional nursing care through skillful assessment, diagnosis, outcomes identification, planning, implementation, and evaluation in accordance with facility or department policies and procedures. Directs and manages the care of designated patients. Utilizes effective and appropriate communication styles. Assists in maintaining a safe work environment and maintains clinical and professional competency as appropriate to the population of patients served.

Job Duties

  • Assesses, plans, implements, and evaluates the care for designated patients. Recognizes the need for and initiates collaboration/communication with physicians, interdisciplinary team members, and takes actions to proactively resolve patients needs.

Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

  3. Experiência na área fiscal de ao menos 2 anos;

  2. Controle de consultas internas e treinamentos às áreas sobre questões do dia a dia que possuam aspectos tributários;

  9. Contatos com consultores externos para a discussão de consultorias estratégicas;
  10. Preparação de Respostas à Fiscalizações da RFB e outros órgãos;
  11. Controle do sistema de captura de projetos elegíveis ao benefício de inovação tecnológica – Lei do Bem.

Qual será a sua missão?
Auxiliar no preparo das refeições, conforme cardápio do dia, de acordo com o padrão de qualidade da empresa, para garantir um ótimo atendimento no refeitório.

Sobre a empresa:
Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil. Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras e, assim, ajudá-los a ter uma vida mais saudável.

Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 76 lojas espalhadas por 4 estados (RJ, SP, ES e MG). Nossas lojas recebem cerca de meio milhão de clientes todos os meses. Com operações no modelo omnichannel, as compras podem ser realizadas também pelo site, app, WhatsApp e marketplaces parceiros, atendendo consumidores nas regiões onde estão presentes em até três horas.

Transportamos 60 mil toneladas de produtos todos os meses, do campo às bancas em até 24 horas. O Hortifruti Natural da Terra é referência em frutas, legumes, verduras e outros alimentos frescos. Unimos a relação de confiança e proximidade com os produtores ao bom atendimento e produtos de qualidade. Não somos um supermercado, nem feira. Mas o melhor dos dois!

Promover uma vida mais natural, nos tornando referência e o principal destino de produtos frescos do Brasil.

Nossos Valores são:

  • Jogo aberto e íntegro;
  • Foco em resultado com qualidade;
  • Trabalho em equipe compartilhando o sucesso;
  • Excelência no Atendimento;
  • Jeito simples e alegre de ser;
  • Atitude Responsável.

Atuamos com profissionalismo, amor e um sorriso estampado no rosto, esse é nosso jeito de ser. Somos mais do que um time, somos uma família!

Queremos promover a diversidade em todos os sentidos e todas as equipes. Por isso, queremos o seu olhar também para torná-lo cada vez mais seguro, acolhedor, criativo e inclusivo. Todas as nossas vagas também são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, e toda a diversidade em relação a raças, cores, religiões, gêneros e orientações sexuais é importante e será muito bem-vinda.

Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Software at TRACTIAN

The software department at TRACTIAN is at the forefront of innovation, crafting an integrated ecosystem that revolutionizes maintenance and process management. Comprising a dynamic team of experts, the department develops an all-in-one software solution that seamlessly combines predictive maintenance capabilities with a comprehensive Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). This visionary approach empowers maintenance and process teams with a unified platform, enabling them to proactively predict equipment failures, optimize maintenance workflows, and enhance operational efficiency. In daily work, the software department drives the convergence of cutting-edge technology and maintenance excellence to propel businesses toward unparalleled success.

What you'll do

As a Staff Frontend Software Engineer , your role will focus on the development and enhancement of key features for our Web applications. You will be responsible for creating and refining features that are both user-centric and effective.

  • Experience in implementing caching strategies or asynchronous state management for high data load applications.
  • Strong knowledge in web performance optimization and cross-platform compatibility.
  • Experience working across engineering teams and other functions in building alignment, driving decision making, and communicating transparently. Experience mentoring and helping in the development of engineers and peers.

Bonus points

  • Track record of leading frontend platform development in a high-growth tech environment.
  • Experience in creating offline applications or desktop applications using Electron/Tauri.
  • Experience in high-volume data processing.
  • Fluent in English.

Company Description

A Serasa Experian é a primeira e a maior Datatech do Brasil. Líder em soluções de inteligência para análise de riscos e oportunidades, com foco nas jornadas de crédito, autenticação e prevenção à fraude. Com tecnologia de ponta, inovação e os melhores talentos, transforma a incerteza do risco na melhor decisão, ajudando pessoas a realizarem seus sonhos e empresas de todos os portes e segmentos a prosperarem.

Temos 22.000 pessoas operando em 32 países e a cada dia estamos investindo em novas tecnologias, profissionais talentosos e inovação para ajudar todos os clientes a maximizarem cada oportunidade. Com sede corporativa em Dublin, Irlanda, a Experian está listada na Bolsa de Valores de Londres (EXPN) e compõe o índice FTSE 100.

Job Description

No time, buscamos cuidar das pessoas, garantir o desenvolvimento e excelência técnica. Valorizamos as pessoas, o time, o trabalho em equipe e o compartilhamento de conhecimento e ideias onde todos têm voz ativa, independente do cargo ou experiência.

Principais Atividades

Sempre procuramos utilizar as boas práticas de engenharia de software, UX design e segurança, como:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando Angular;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de design para criar interfaces de usuário intuitivas e responsivas;
  • Implementar melhores práticas de desenvolvimento, garantindo a qualidade e performance do código;
  • Participar de revisões de código e fornecer feedback construtivo para outros desenvolvedores;
  • Integrar APIs e serviços de backend com as aplicações frontend;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as novas tendências e tecnologias no desenvolvimento web.

Seus Desafios Serão

  • Garantir a compatibilidade das aplicações com diferentes navegadores e dispositivos;
  • Resolver problemas complexos de usabilidade e performance;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, adaptando-se rapidamente às mudanças e novas demandas;
  • Colaborar efetivamente com equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo designers, desenvolvedores backend e gerentes de produto;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento e das práticas de codificação.

Qualifications

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento frontend com Angular 12+ com uso de Module Federation;
  • Conhecimento sólido de HTML, CSS, JavaScript e TypeScript;
  • Experiência com integração de APIs;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código;
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas de forma criativa e eficiente;
  • Experiência com quebra e/ou uso de microfrontends.

Additional Information

A Serasa Experian é muito mais do que você imagina. Com o propósito de criar um futuro melhor, ampliando oportunidades para pessoas e empresas, no Brasil somos mais de 4 mil pessoas que atuam em diversos times e especialidades. Aqui, cada conhecimento e diversidade se complementa e você pode trabalhar no que mais ama, estamos comprometidos a construir uma cultura inclusiva e um ambiente no qual pessoas possam equilibrar a carreira com seus compromissos e interesses pessoais, prezando pelo bem-estar.

A gente se dedica muito em ser uma das melhores e mais inovadoras empresas para se trabalhar do país, possibilitando experiências e carreiras incríveis para nossas pessoas. Nossa forte abordagem de pessoas em primeiro lugar é reconhecida externamente por meio de diversas certificações de mercado: fomos premiados pelo Great Place To Work em 24 países e pela certificação internacional Top Employers, além de sermos reconhecidos como uma das melhores empresas para jovens profissionais e contarmos com uma avaliação de 4,6 no Glassdoor. Cada reconhecimento nos indica que estamos no caminho certo, proporcionando um ambiente de trabalho cada vez melhor para nossos talentos.

description:
Especialista de Recursos Humanos - Educação Corporativa

Join to apply for the Especialista de Recursos Humanos - Educação Corporativa role at Banco ABC Brasil

Job Description
A área de Educação Corporativa desempenha um papel estratégico no desenvolvimento de talentos, possibilitando que os colaboradores estejam alinhados às demandas do mercado financeiro e as diretrizes estratégicas da organização. Promove a capacitação contínua em diversos temas, desde técnicos funcionais a jornadas estruturadas de desenvolvimento comercial, capabilities habilitadoras para evolução da organização. Além disso, contribui para a retenção de profissionais qualificados, fomenta uma cultura de aprendizado e apoia a adaptação a mudanças regulatórias e tecnológicas, impulsionando o crescimento sustentável do negócio.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de capacitação para aprimorar a performance da equipe comercial e relacionamento com clientes;
  • Levantamento de Necessidades: Diagnosticar lacunas de conhecimento e competências alinhando os programas de treinamento com os objetivos estratégicos do Banco.
  • Desenvolvimento e Conteúdo: criar ou personalizar treinamentos sobre produtos financeiros, técnicas de negociação, gestão de carteira, tendências e etc.
  • Gestão e implementação de Treinamentos: Coordenar programas de capacitação presenciais e online, utilizando metodologias inovadoras e tecnologias educacionais;
  • Parceria com liderança - trabalhar em conjunto com diversos níveis hierárquicos de gestão (em especial comercial) para garantir que os treinamentos atendam as demandas reais de mercado e da equipe comercial;
  • Medicação de impacto: acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPI) para avaliar efetividade e seu impacto nos resultados comerciais;
  • Relacionamento com fornecedores: Gerenciar parcerias com consultorias, certificadoras e especialistas em equipes comerciais;
  • Esse profissional desempenha um papel essencial na maximização do desempenho da equipe comercial, impulsionando vendas, melhorando a experiência do cliente e garantindo conformidade com normas e estratégia do Banco.

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Nível superior completo, Pós/MBA em Educação Corporativa, Gestão Comercial, Finanças ou áreas correlatas será um diferencial.
  • Atuação avançada em educação corporativa, treinamento e desenvolvimento em áreas comerciais de banco de atacado, corporate ou investimentos;
  • Metodologias de ensino para adultos, design instrucional e novas tecnologias educacionais (LMS, e-learning, gamificação)
  • Conhecimento sobre plataformas de gestão de aprendizagem - LMS / LXP
  • Comunicação e influência - habilidades para engajar equipes comerciais, gerentes e stakeholders internos;
  • Capacidade analítica - uso de dados para identificar gaps de conhecimento e sugerir melhorias;
  • Gestão de projetos: organização para estruturar e gerenciar múltiplos programas de capacitação simultaneamente;
  • Relacionamento Interpessoal: Trabalho colaborativo, com times comerciais, RH, compliance e áreas de negócio.

Diferenciais

  • Domínio das certificações comerciais: CPA-20 / CEA / CFP / CFA.
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis e inovação em aprendizagem (microlearning, IA na educação etc)
  • Fluência em inglês para desenvolver relatórios e consultar materiais internacionais.

Additional information

  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica Omint;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • PLR;
  • PPR;
  • ABC com Você: um programa que cuida dos colaboradores e seus familiares, com assistência jurídica, social, psicológica e financeira;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Licença Paternidade e Maternidade estendidas: paternidade 20 dias e maternidade 6 meses;
  • Auxílio Creche/Babá;

Process stages

  • Step 1: Registration
  • Step 2: Triagem
  • Step 3: Entrevista - Atração de Talentos
  • Step 4: Entrevista - Gestor

Quem somos
Somos um banco múltiplo, especializado na concessão de crédito e serviços para empresas de médio e grande porte, sendo um dos únicos no país com suporte de um controlador internacional combinado a uma forte autonomia de gestão local. Com amplo portfólio de produtos, há mais de 30 anos auxiliamos os clientes a encontrar as melhores soluções para os seus negócios. Listado desde 2007 no Nível 2 de governança corporativa da B3, recentemente expandimos nossa atuação também para as áreas de Comercialização de Energia e Corretagem de Seguros. Temos como foco a nossa evolução contínua. Para isso, valorizamos profissionais que desejam ser protagonistas de suas carreiras.
Buscamos oferecer aos nossos colaboradores um ambiente cheio de oportunidades de desenvolvimento, onde prezamos por relações colaborativas e abertura para falar e ser ouvido. Sevan Multi-Site Solutions is a veteran-owned business that provides construction, program management, real estate & site development, and architecture & engineering services for restaurant, grocery, fuel and convenience store, retail, and government sectors nationwide. We work with leading brands like McDonald’s, Starbucks, Sprouts, and BP, to name a few. At Sevan, we provide the talent, technology, and trusted expertise needed to consistently deliver excellence in multi-site construction.

Sevan is an INC. 5000 Fastest-Growing Company – Great Places to Work 2024 – 2024 HIRE Vets Gold Medallion Award - Best Places to work in Chicago ’20, ’21, ’22, ’23, – Best Places to Work in Construction 2023, 2024

The Design Lead is as a member of the Architecture & Design studio and works alongside a group of individuals to provide architectural services within a dedicated design team. A design professional, accountable for managing and producing accurate design and construction documents for our multi-site clients, and leading and supporting other team members in achieving team goals. Experience with multi-site restaurant, retail, grocery, and/or fuel projects is highly preferred.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prepares complete, accurate and code compliant construction documents.
  • Provides technical and creative design solutions that align with program intent.
  • Applies client’s program requirements and designs criteria to existing buildings and structures.
  • Responsible for determining the appropriate building components and their design application.
  • Responsible for maintaining project design schedules, deadlines, and commitments for small and medium-scope assignments of average difficulty.
  • Coordinates work with consultants, contractors, fabricators, specification writers, and regulatory agencies to meet overall project objectives.
  • Notifies supervisor of changes in project scope and advises if a change order proposal is needed.
  • Possesses a working knowledge of building codes and ADA requirements and provides such expertise to the assigned projects/programs.
  • Conducts project due diligence with municipalities to determine local zoning and building code requirements.
  • Accountable for resolving plan review comments from code officials.
  • Accountable for design quality control and technical accuracy of team assignments.
  • Assists the project liaison to code officials, outside consultants, suppliers, and contractors regarding questions of the construction documents.
  • Confirms and verifies design requirements related to the project or program.
  • Follows established standards and procedures for project reporting and documentation.
  • Oversees and directs designers and technicians, ensuring high productivity and project success.
  • Reviews / evaluates other’s work and provide productive feedback and technical direction.
  • Works with supervisor and peers to pursue professional development.
  • Proactively identifies, solves, or elevates project issues related to design, safety, or quality.
  • Adheres to CAD/REVIT standards and follows assigned drafting protocol across all projects.
  • Works with supervisor and peers to pursue professional development.
  • Accountable for timely completion of assigned projects.
  • May represent the company at client project meetings. Visits project sites to verify scope, exiting conditions and other related activities.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently as well as within a team setting.
  • Capable of prioritizing and working on multiple projects at the same time.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 4-year degree in Architecture or equivalent; 5+ or more years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated skills in design production management.
  • Pursing Architect license, preferred.
  • Able to articulate and apply comprehensive knowledge of architectural principles, practices, and advanced techniques.
  • Demonstrated expertise in drawings, specifications, and building materials.
  • Demonstrated experience completing moderately difficult architectural assignments with minimal supervision.
  • Able to execute and coordinate multiple projects at a time.
  • Experience in multi-site projects preferred.
  • Highly proficient working in AutoCAD and highly proficient working in Revit. Proficiency with Illustrator, Photoshop, SketchUp (preferred), Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Smartsheet, 3D Studio Max is preferred.

Language & Collaboration Requirements:
This role requires full professional fluency in English, including reading, writing, and speaking. Candidates must be comfortable working in an English-speaking environment and regularly communicating with U.S.-based colleagues and clients. All meetings, documentation, and project coordination will be conducted in English. Candidates must be available to work standard U.S. business hours.

Work Conditions:

This role is remote based and will work closely with Architects, Designers, Engineers, and clients in the U.S. Multi-shift work may often be required to accomplish work to meet aggressive schedules. Must be flexible, adaptable, and able to work with fluid schedules. Able to work remotely in a home office setting and manage time effectively with multiple projects and deadlines.

Why Join Sevan?

At Sevan, we believe in creating a supportive and dynamic environment where your contributions truly matter. Here’s what you can expect as part of our team:

  • Live Our Values: Join a company that values integrity, respect, teamwork, excellence, and charity. These principles are at the heart of everything we do.
  • Champion Key Initiatives: Play a vital role in driving Sevan-wide initiatives like Safety and Sustainability, ensuring positive impacts for our people and the planet.
  • Inspire and Lead: Help us bring our vision to life by embracing our commitment to Service, Talent, and Choices—you’ll have a voice in shaping the future.
  • Set the Standard: Be a role model for professional behavior, fostering a workplace culture that motivates and inspires others.
  • Grow With Us: Take charge of your personal and professional growth through hands-on experience, engaging training programs, and opportunities to mentor interns and co-ops.
  • Support Development of Top Brands: Opportunity to work behind the scenes supporting efforts for industry leaders like McDonald’s, Starbucks, and 7-Eleven.

Sevan Multi-Site Solutions, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, genetics, disability, pregnancy, veteran status or any other basis protected by law.

  • High level proficiency in English
  • A valid driving licence

Having the following qualifications would be an advantage:

title: Director/GM Brazil
description:
The General Manager/Director oversees sales operations within Sciex in the eastern Latin America markets, focusing on revenue growth. This role involves managing a sales team, developing market strategies, building customer relationships, and meeting sales targets while complying with local and regional regulations. Strong leadership, communication, and negotiation skills are required, along with a deep understanding of the regional business landscape.

Reporting to the Vice President & General Manager, Americas, this position is part of the Commercial Team located in São Paulo, Brazil , and will be on-site.

In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to:

  • Create and execute comprehensive sales strategies that align with overall company goals, identify market opportunities, and analyze the competitive landscape within the regional markets.
  • Manage and motivate a team of sales representatives by setting clear expectations, coaching on advanced sales techniques, and providing ongoing performance feedback, ensuring optimal team performance.
  • Build and nurture strong client relationships by understanding their needs and proactively addressing their concerns, guaranteeing customer retention and satisfaction.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the direct and indirect markets by generating leads and actively engaging potential new customers.
  • Accurately forecast sales performance and monitor key metrics, providing regular reports to senior management on sales activities and results.
  • Negotiate deals with customers to ensure profitable pricing strategies and manage complex sales cycles effectively.
  • Stay informed about market trends, economic conditions, and regulatory changes and adapt sales strategies accordingly.
  • Collaborate with marketing, product development, and other departments to ensure alignment and support commercial initiatives.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Portuguese and English are essential for effective interaction with clients and team members across the greater American regions.
  • Proven track record of successfully leading sales teams, exceeding sales targets, and coaching sales representatives to achieve optimal performance.
  • Deep knowledge of the Latin America business landscape and life sciences industry, including key industries, customer segments, and competitive dynamics.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to develop and maintain robust customer relationships at all levels.
  • Ability to negotiate effectively with customers to close deals and achieve favorable terms.
  • Inspirational leadership skills to foster a positive work environment, promote collaboration, and motivate the team.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, both domestically and internationally, including overnight stays.
  • Possess or can obtain a valid driver’s license and maintain an acceptable driving record.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Intermediate or advanced Spanish communication.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.


The Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Data Architect to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.


Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Data Architect you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS.


As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project. These professional services engagements will focus on customer solutions such as Data and Business intelligence, machine Learning and batch/real-time data processing.


Key job responsibilities

As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:

  1. Help the customer to define and implement data architectures (Data Lake, Lake House, Data Mesh, etc). Engagements include short on-site projects proving the use of AWS Data services to support new distributed computing solutions that often span private cloud and public cloud services.
  2. Deliver on-site technical assessments with partners and customers. This includes participating in pre-sales visits, understanding customer requirements, creating packaged Data & Analytics service offerings.
  3. Engaging with the customer’s business and technology stakeholders to create a compelling vision of a data-driven enterprise in their environment. Create new artifacts that promote code reuse.
  4. Collaborate with AWS field sales, pre-sales, training and support teams to help partners and customers learn and use AWS services such as Athena, Glue, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, Amazon EMR and Amazon Redshift.

Since this is a customer facing role, you might be required to travel to client locations and deliver professional services when needed, up to 50%.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of experience in cloud architecture and implementation, preferably with AWS
- 3+ years of database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis) experience
- 3+ Experience delivering cloud projects or cloud based solutions
- Able to communicate effectively in English, within technical and business settings.
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, or related field.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
- Proficiency in a wide range of AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation)
- Experience with automation and scripting (e.g., Terraform, Python)
- Expertise in performance optimization and cost management for cloud environments
- Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment
- AWS Professional level certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional) preferred

Somos o Grupo Energisa!

Com mais de cem anos de história, a Energisa é o maior grupo privado com controle 100% nacional do setor elétrico brasileiro. Nosso portfólio diversificado abrange distribuidoras, concessões de transmissão, geração de grande porte renovável, uma marca inovadora de soluções energéticas – a (re)energisa –, com geração distribuída por fonte renovável, comercialização de energia no mercado livre e serviços de valor agregado, além de uma central de serviços compartilhados, uma empresa de contact center e a fintech Voltz, a primeira do nosso setor no mercado de contas digitais. Recentemente, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a inclusão da distribuição de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás. Transformamos, através de nossos mais de 17.000 colaboradores, energia em conforto e desenvolvimento para mais de 20 milhões de pessoas. Acreditamos na força da diversidade e da pluralidade para gerar inovação e atingir resultados incríveis. Aqui todos são muito bem-vindos! Quer fazer parte desta história? Confere se esta oportunidade tem match com o seu perfil e vem conosco participar desta jornada de seleção!

Responsabilidades:

  • Participar das negociações de metas dos indicadores comerciais de Gestão;
  • Analisar, acompanhar, desdobrar e consolidar os indicadores comerciais de Gestão;
  • Elaborar, analisar, criticar e divulgar relatórios analíticos e de acompanhamento de dados;
  • Analisar os resultados dos processos comerciais e diagnosticar as variações ocorridas;
  • Ministrar treinamento comercial a atendentes, leituristas, eletricistas e afins, a despeito de novas implementações em sistemas comerciais internos e resoluções da ANEEL;
  • Acompanhar, criticar e consolidar os orçamentos de despesas e dos Departamentos e Assessorias ligados à Distribuidora e Diretoria Comercial;

  • Acompanhar a efetividade e eficácia das inspeções em medições para aperfeiçoamento das regras e perfis de irregularidades;

Requisitos Mínimos:

Benefícios:

As PESSOAS aqui são nossa maior ENERGIA. Pensando em seu bem-estar, oferecemos um leque de benefícios:

  • Gympass que te dá acesso a mais de 18 mil academias no Brasil.

Etapas do Processo:

  • Step 5: AVALIAÇÃO DE PERFIL

Você já sabia que somos o maior grupo privado do setor elétrico com capital 100% nacional ? São 118 anos de história, onde atuamos principalmente na distribuição de energia. Imagina só a responsabilidade de atender a mais de 20 milhões de pessoas nos estados do Acre, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraíba, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rondônia, São Paulo, Sergipe e Tocantins.

Com certeza, este é o nosso trabalho de maior visibilidade. Só que tem muito mais. Com a missão de transformar energia em conforto, em desenvolvimento e em novas possibilidades com sustentabilidade, criamos um ecossistema de soluções energéticas inovadoras .

Ou seja, além da distribuição de energia, seu talento também pode fazer a diferença na (re)energisa , nossa empresa que atua na geração distribuída através de fontes renováveis , no Mercado Livre de Energia e na oferta de soluções de valor agregado. E ainda temos outras frentes como o setor de transmissão de energia e os serviços e produtos financeiros com a nossa fintech das utilities, a Voltz . Recentemente, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a inclusão da distribuição de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás .

La empresa LAKAUT SA se encuentra en la búsqueda de un Gerente de Desarrollo de Negocios Digitales.

El lugar de trabajo será en la oficina de Lima 355 CABA y será 100% presencial en el horario de lunes a viernes de 09 a 18 hs. Por favor, enviar junto a la postulación la pretensión salarial.

Descripción del puesto:

El Gerente de Desarrollo de Negocios Digitales es responsable de identificar, diseñar y ejecutar estrategias comerciales orientadas a la expansión del negocio en el entorno digital.

Su misión principal es generar oportunidades comerciales sostenibles mediante el análisis de mercados, la identificación de clientes potenciales y la implementación de estrategias de vinculación comercial, con foco en la solución de Firma Digital de Lakaut.

Responsabilidades principales:

  1. Análisis y definición del mercado objetivo: Identificar segmentos de mercado prioritarios, principales referentes o tomadores de decisión, ubicación geográfica, tamaño y perfil de empresas objetivo.
  2. Diseño de estrategias comerciales: Definir y ejecutar campañas de contacto y vinculación con clientes potenciales a través de diversos canales (emailing, LinkedIn, eventos, networking, etc.).
  3. Agenda comercial y planificación de contacto: Establecer cronogramas de contacto, seguimiento y reuniones con clientes potenciales, manteniendo una agenda activa enfocada en la conversión.
  4. Presentación de soluciones y consultoría comercial: Coordinar y liderar reuniones de presentación de productos o servicios digitales, comunicando claramente la propuesta de valor, funcionalidades, integración con sistemas del cliente, casos de uso y aspectos técnicos relevantes.
  5. Gestión de la base de clientes: Monitorear y actualizar oportunidades comerciales, reportar avances, métricas clave (KPI) y proyecciones de cierre a la dirección comercial.
  6. Colaboración interna: Trabajar en conjunto con los equipos involucrados en firma digital para alinear las propuestas comerciales con capacidades técnicas y necesidades del mercado.
  7. Fidelización y desarrollo de cuentas: Acompañar al cliente en etapas tempranas del onboarding y en la evolución de la relación comercial, identificando nuevas oportunidades y fidelizando.

Perfil deseado:

  1. Experiencia mínima de 4 a 6 años en roles de desarrollo de negocios B2B, preferentemente en empresas tecnológicas o de servicios digitales.
  2. Dominio de herramientas CRM, paquete Office/G Suite y plataformas de automatización de marketing.
  3. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación.
  4. Capacidad analítica, orientación a resultados y proactividad.
  5. Conocimiento del entorno digital y terminología técnica para asesorar y responder consultas de clientes.

title: Mid-Level Data Security Analyst
description:
EBANX é o principal parceiro de pagamentos conectando empresas globais com clientes dos mercados digitais de crescimento mais rápido do mundo.

Desde o início de nossa jornada, temos a mesma missão: dar acesso em escala global e para todos. Acreditamos que transformar desafios em oportunidades e tornar o impossível parte da jornada é crucial! É exatamente por isso que criamos uma solução de pagamentos que constrói pontes entre pessoas e empresas globais todos os dias nos 29 mercados em ascensão em que operamos.

Nós somos ebankers, somos pensadores globais, valorizamos a diversidade, fomentamos a criatividade e trabalhamos duro para conectar empresas e pessoas, um pagamento de cada vez. Vamos fazer história juntos?

Como Data Security Analyst , sua missão será implementar e gerenciar controles de segurança com foco na proteção dos dados.

Você também será responsável por:

  • Proteger dados em repouso, trânsito e uso: implementar e gerenciar controles de segurança (criptografia, DLP, etc.) em todo o ciclo de vida dos dados;
  • Monitorar e responder a incidentes: detectar atividades suspeitas, investigar incidentes de segurança e implementar medidas corretivas;
  • Gerenciar acesso e identidade: implementar políticas de controle de acesso (IAM, MFA) para garantir que apenas usuários autorizados acessem os dados;
  • Garantir conformidade: assegurar que os sistemas de dados cumpram regulamentações como LGPD, GDPR, etc., realizando auditorias e avaliações de risco;
  • Automatizar segurança: automatizar tarefas de segurança, como monitoramento e resposta a incidentes, para aumentar a eficiência;
  • Analisar vulnerabilidades: realizar testes de vulnerabilidade e penetração para identificar e corrigir falhas de segurança;
  • Colaborar: trabalhar com equipes de engenharia, desenvolvimento, operações, segurança e dados para integrar a segurança em todos os processos.

Principais requisitos para esta posição:

  • Segurança de dados: criptografia, mascaramento, DLP, etc.
  • Ferramentas de segurança: SIEM, firewalls, análise de vulnerabilidades, etc.
  • Bancos de dados e Big Data: SQL, NoSQL, ETL, Data Lakes, Data Warehouses.
  • Programação/Scripting: Python, Java.
  • Sistemas e Redes: Windows, Linux, TCP/IP.
  • Frameworks de segurança: NIST, CIS, ISO 27001, etc.

O que seria um diferencial?

  • Conhecimento de nuvem: AWS, Azure, GCP (desejável);
  • Mentalidade Proativa: capacidade de identificar riscos e sugerir melhorias práticas para fortalecer a segurança dos dados;
  • Habilidades Analíticas: facilidade para interpretar logs, identificar padrões e apoiar na investigação de incidentes;
  • Conhecimento em Ferramentas de Automação: noções de automação de tarefas de segurança usando scripts simples;
  • Boa comunicação: habilidade para colaborar com diferentes equipes e explicar conceitos técnicos de forma clara;
  • Capacidade de aprendizado contínuo: interesse em se manter atualizado com boas práticas e tendências em segurança de dados;
  • Visão colaborativa: facilidade em trabalhar com equipes multidisciplinares, apoiando na construção de soluções seguras.

Benefícios adicionais incluem aulas de espanhol, inglês e português, auxílio-refeição, vale-transporte, programas de desenvolvimento, benefícios de saúde, seguro de vida, descontos exclusivos, entre outros.

Candidatar a esta vaga

Campos obrigatórios incluem localização, Aviso de Privacidade, níveis de inglês e espanhol, informações demográficas, entre outros. Ao candidatar-se, você declara ter lido e concordado com o Aviso de Privacidade do EBANX, permitindo o uso de seus dados para processos seletivos e armazenamento por até 5 anos. O preenchimento de informações demográficas é opcional, mas recomendado para fins de diversidade e inclusão.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on QA Engineering Lead to shape and scale Sardine’s end-to-end quality function - spanning automation, manual testing, frameworks, and strategy. You’ll lead a growing team of QA engineers while also contributing technically to ensure our products are robust, scalable, and reliable. This is a 70% IC and 30% management role.

This high-impact, cross-functional role involves close collaboration with Product, Sales, and Engineering. This role is ideally suited for someone who thrives in a high-ownership environment, is motivated to build scalable systems, and wants to shape the quality function from the ground up.

What you’ll be doing

70% IC Scope + 30% Manager

  • Proficiency with modern test frameworks (e.g., Cypress, Selenium, Playwright)

  • Solid understanding of CI/CD workflows and how to integrate automated tests

  • Strong communicator with a bias toward action, ownership, and continuous improvement

Compensation: Base pay range of 360,000 – 455,000 BRL + Series C equity with tremendous upside potential + Attractive benefits

Sobre a Alice

Somos a Alice, a primeira gestora de saúde do Brasil. Acreditamos em um modelo de saúde inovador e colocamos o nosso membro no centro das decisões por meio da tecnologia, empatia, transparência e simplicidade. A nossa missão é tornar o mundo mais saudável e este não é um desafio fácil. Revolucionar a saúde no Brasil requer resiliência, energia e inovação. Estamos em constante desenvolvimento e incentivamos Pitayas {como chamamos as pessoas do nosso time} a crescerem junto com a gente.

Para isso, buscamos um profissional que nos ajude, cada vez mais, a transformar vidas.

Na Alice, esperamos que você:

  • Trabalhe com paixão pelo propósito, fazendo da missão da Alice a sua missão;
  • Vá pra Arena e busque ser protagonista, desafiando o status-quo e tendo atitude e coragem de quem quer mudar;
  • Esteja sempre subindo a barra e evoluindo todos os dias, para entregar o melhor que é possível sonhar;
  • Se importe com as pessoas, genuinamente, entendendo seus problemas com empatia e ajudando-a a resolvê-los;
  • Valorize trabalhar em um ambiente aberto, inclusivo e transparente, onde se possa ser quem verdadeiramente é;
  • Priorize a sua saúde e felicidade, afinal um time mais saudável gera mais valor.

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um Analista Comercial que nos ajude a escalar nossas operações de suporte aos nossos parceiros (hospitais, laboratórios e clínicas da nossa Comunidade de Saúde), garantindo uma experiência incrível e de alta qualidade, resolutividade e que promova a confiança e satisfação entre as partes. Forte comunicador, organizado e executor, que saiba navegar com diversas áreas dentro e fora da Alice para resolver as demandas que surgirem e que se estimule em um ambiente de mudanças rápidas, sendo protagonista em encontrar oportunidades de melhoria operacional e construção de fluxos redondos e sem fricção para os parceiros.

Localização e Formato de Trabalho:

Buscamos candidatos que residam em São Paulo - SP e estejam disponíveis para trabalho presencial em média 3x por semana. Nosso endereço é na Avenida Rebouças, 3535 - Pinheiros.
Confira o espaço no nosso vídeo: Alice Tour

Sobre a área de HCDev na Alice:

Na Alice, a área de Health Community Development {Desenvolvimento da Comunidade de Saúde} é responsável por toda a estratégia de construção da Health Community {rede credenciada}. A comunidade é formada por hospitais, laboratórios e clínicas e um dos nossos grandes desafios é manter os parceiros engajados e felizes com nossa operação e nosso modelo de cuidado. Para isso, precisamos manter contato com os nossos parceiros, ser resolutivos em qualquer tipo de demanda e garantir fluidez nos fluxos operacionais. Nosso grande objetivo é ser partner-of-choice das instituições, a ponto que elas nos escolham como operadora de saúde e vejam muito valor em trabalhar conosco.

Valorizamos a empatia, inovação e excelência em tudo o que fazemos. Buscamos pessoas que compartilhem nossa paixão por transformar a saúde e se unam a nós para criar uma experiência de saúde personalizada, escalável e acessível. Como Analista Comercial, você terá um papel essencial na criação de uma experiência positiva para nossos parceiros da HC em diversos pontos da jornada, contribuindo para o nosso crescimento e escalabilidade.

Nosso desafio

Para entregar a missão da Alice de tornar o mundo mais saudável, o time de Health Community Development é responsável por construir uma comunidade de saúde (rede credenciada) estratégica para os nossos membros. Além disso, a Alice precisa ser partner-of-choice das instituições, por meio de um excelente relacionamento, incentivos alinhados e operação sem fricção.

No dia a dia você deverá:

  • Resolver problemas e demandas operacionais que impactem na experiência do membro, através do contato e articulação com áreas parceiras (coordenação de cuidado, health ops, legal, etc) de forma ágil e resolutiva;
  • Ser ponto de contato com analistas comerciais dos hospitais, laboratórios e clínicas, garantindo um suporte eficaz;
  • Ser dono dos indicadores operacionais de suas demandas, como: tempo de primeira resposta, tempo total de resolução, satisfação do parceiro e resolutividade;
  • Pensar e construir novos fluxos, a fim de melhorar a efetividade da resolução dos problemas e transformar a área em uma área mais escalável e ágil;
  • Ser protagonista e liderar, com autonomia, a implementação de novas ferramentas e novos fluxos que otimizem as operações e promovam a escalabilidade dos serviços;

O que faz de você um candidato forte:

  • Comunicação clara e resolutiva para endereçar as demandas operacionais;
  • Organização e agilidade para garantir a satisfação dos prestadores, através do rápido retorno;
  • Olhar crítico sobre a operação, para definir rotinas e projetos, priorizando soluções estruturais para temas de maior impacto;
  • Habilidade para interagir com diferentes equipes, como áreas internas da Alice e áreas operacionais de hospitais, laboratórios e clínicas;
  • Orientação para as instituições de saúde e empatia: preocupação genuína com as necessidades e expectativas dos parceiros e dos membros, e um forte compromisso com a excelência e reforço de confiança em cada ponto de contato;
  • Compromisso com a melhoria contínua, sempre buscando oportunidades para otimizar processos e inovar na operação;
  • (Diferencial): Experiência e conhecimento prévio com ferramentas de organização como Slack, Notion, Trello, Zendesk;
  • (Diferencial): Experiência prévia em áreas comerciais e ou operacionais que envolvam comunicação com clientes externos.

description:
Job description

Desenvolver as atividades ligadas á segurança do trabalho, visando assegurar condições que eliminem ou reduzam ao mínimo os riscos de ocorrência de acidentes de trabalho, observando o cumprimento de toda a legislação pertinente.


Main responsibilities

  1. PLANEJAR juntamente com Supervisores e/ou Encarregados de Setor os trabalhos que, após análise de risco, suscitem cuidados especiais tais como, operações em altura, espaços confinados e afins.
  2. PROMOVER inspeções nos locais de trabalho, identificando condições perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de riscos.
  3. TREINAR e conscientizar os colaboradores quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho.
  4. DISTRIBUIR os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI).
  5. INDICAR, SOLICITAR e INSPECIONAR equipamentos de proteção individual e coletivo, visando à redução dos riscos à segurança e integridade física do colaborador.
  6. INVESTIGAR acidentes de trabalho, analisando e determinando suas causas, além de propor recomendações técnicas.
  7. CONTRIBUIR para a elaboração de mapas de risco PPP, PPRA, CAT, como também responsável pela guarda destes documentos.
  8. ELABORAR relatórios pertinentes à atividade.
  9. PARTICIPAR dos Cursos Normativos obrigatórios da empresa.
  10. ORIENTAR as atividades desenvolvidas por empresas contratadas, quanto aos procedimentos de segurança e higiene dos trabalhos previstos na legislação ou em contratos de prestação de serviços.
  11. COLABORAR com a CIPA em seus programas, estudando suas observações e proposições, visando a adotar soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho.
  12. REALIZAR ensaio de vedação nos colaboradores que usam “máscara semi-facial” sempre que necessário para garantir a vedação adequada da mesma e consequentemente proporcionar uma boa proteção ao usuário.
  13. PREPARAR programas de treinamento, admissional e de rotina, sobre segurança do trabalho, incluindo programas de conscientização e divulgação de normas e procedimentos de segurança.
  14. AUXILIAR na execução das normas de segurança referentes a projetos de construção, ampliação, reforma, arranjos físicos e de fluxos, com vistas à observância das medidas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, inclusive de terceiros.
  15. ACOMPANHAR perícias, junto com o SESMT, realizadas por Órgãos Fiscalizadores.
  16. ORGANIZAR as atividades da SIPAT, com o apoio dos demais setores envolvidos.

Requirements and skills

  1. Experiência na área;
  2. Curso Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho;
  3. Conhecimento em Word e Excel;
  4. Conhecimento das NR’s;
  5. Análise Crítica;
  6. Boa Comunicação;
  7. Desejável: Cursando nível superior de áreas afins;
  8. Ter disponibilidade de viagens para outras unidades do Grupo Elizabeth.

Additional information

  • Plano de saúde;

title: Safety Assurance Engineer (Engenheiro de Segurança Ferroviária)
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the Safety Assurance Engineer in São Paulo we’re looking for?

This opportunity is not related to EHS (Environmental Safety and Health) metier.

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your safety and risk management expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside proactive and detail-oriented teammates.

You'll play a critical role in ensuring the safety of our signalling projects and products while driving compliance with safety standards and regulations. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (project teams, external and internal Independent Safety Assessors, customers, and safety consultants), manage safety activities, and provide technical support to Safety Assurance Engineers, among other responsibilities.

You’ll specifically take care of safety analysis at various levels (system, subsystem, wayside equipment, onboard equipment, hardware, and software), but also manage safety demonstrations through Safety Cases or Safety Reports.

We’ll look to you for:

  1. Performing technical safety analyses such as Preliminary Hazard Analysis (PHA), System Hazard Analysis (SHA), and Hardware Analysis.

  2. Defining and transferring safety requirements to mitigate railway safety risks and tracking them to closure.

  3. Supporting the Project Quality Manager during Safety Design Reviews and Safety Authorizations.

  4. Acting as a Safety Leader to address safety issues and ensure their resolution.

  5. Meeting quality, cost, and delivery (QCD) objectives.

  6. Applying Alstom’s Railway Safety Processes and Instructions to projects and programs.

  7. Providing proactive design assessments to define technical solutions for railway safety risks.

  8. Participating in the improvement and definition of safety processes.

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, System, Computer, Automation, Mechanical Engineering.

  • Desirable knowledge of signalling systems and CENELEC standards (50126, 50128, and 50129).

  • Experience or understanding of safety analysis and risk management.

  • Knowledge of electronics and railway systems (beginner to experienced level).

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a rigorous and detail-oriented approach.

  • Ability to work autonomously and collaborate within a team.

  • Proactive mindset with a sense of urgency and anticipation.

  • Advanced English proficiency; Spanish is a plus.

  • Willingness to travel sporadically.

Things you’ll enjoy

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

  • Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career.

  • Work with advanced safety standards for rail signalling.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and supportive colleagues.

  • Contribute to innovative and impactful projects.

  • Utilise our dynamic and inclusive working environment.

  • Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.

  • Benefit from our investment in your development through award-winning learning opportunities.

  • Progress towards leadership roles in safety assurance and project management.

  • Enjoy a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Join to apply for the Software Engineer - Python - Ubuntu Pro client - graduate level role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu Pro client.
Ubuntu Pro is a suite of specialist services provided by Canonical. Whether for enterprise customers deploying systems at scale or users who want security patching for their personal Ubuntu LTS at home, the Ubuntu Pro Client is the command-line tool that manages all these services.
The quality and stability of the Ubuntu Pro Client is critically important, since it comes pre-installed on every Ubuntu system. You'll work with the Ubuntu Server team, alongside major cloud partners and multiple Canonical product teams to develop, test and release improvements to the Pro client. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.
This role requires quality-oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability over a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The Pro client often interacts with the Ubuntu package management; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role.
Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. The Pro client is used at all ranges, from mission-critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with all of them in mind.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
  • Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have extensive experience with Python on Linux
  • You have interest in and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux systems administration, continuous integration, end-system contract management, Debian packaging, working with public or on premise clouds
  • Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Full stack Software Developer – Software Defined Networks
description:
We are looking for a skilled, innovative, and hands-on System Developer to join our Strategy and Technology Digital Mine Venture team. This role will require experience in hands-on coding and developing advanced network services in Linux-based systems to join our cognitive digital mining venture. This role focuses on designing and implementing critical network services such as MPLS, SD-WAN, and SDN within mission-critical communication platforms tailored for the mining, energy, and oil & gas sectors. The ideal candidate will be adept at working in a dynamic, high-energy environment, bringing cutting-edge solutions to life through hands-on coding and deep network expertise.

Qualifications

You have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related field. Advanced degrees or certifications in network engineering are a plus.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English is essential; Spanish is a plus.
  • Familiarity with mission-critical environments in the mining, energy, or oil & gas sectors is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or similar tools for containerization and orchestration is beneficial for managing complex deployments.
  • Strong experience with MPLS, SD-WAN, SDN, and related network technologies. Proficiency in protocols like BGP, OSPF, and VRRP for efficient traffic routing and management.
  • Proficiency in languages like Python, C, C++, or Go for developing network services. Experience in automation scripting to support network configuration and deployment tasks.
  • Solid understanding of Linux-based systems, including networking configurations, kernel tuning, and firewall management.
  • Knowledge of how to manage cellular and wireless interfaces, such as LTE, 5G, and Wi-Fi, is a plus, especially in the context of integrating and optimizing connectivity within communication platforms.

It would be nice if you also had:

  • Knowledge of network security standards and protocols, such as IPSec, SSL/TLS, and firewall management, to safeguard data and network infrastructure.
  • Experience with network diagnostic and debugging tools, such as Wireshark, tcpdump, and Nmap, to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize network performance.
  • Comfortable working within Scrum or agile methodologies. Strong team player with experience in fast-paced, iterative development environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy advanced network services, including MPLS, SD-WAN, and SDN, for highly resilient communication platforms in industrial environments. Ensure low latency, reliability, and scalability in challenging conditions.
  • Write, test, and optimize code for network service features, focusing on performance, resilience, and security. Develop custom solutions to enable seamless communication across distributed systems.
  • Lead the configuration, deployment, and management of SD-WAN and SDN technologies to enhance network flexibility and adaptability in mission-critical environments. Knowledge of SNMP, TR069 management protocols.
  • Integrate and optimize MPLS services to provide high-performance, efficient data routing and network traffic management. Configure MPLS networks to meet the specific needs of mining and energy operations.
  • Work closely with Bell Labs researchers, embracing hands-on collaboration to explore and integrate cutting-edge innovations into practical business applications. Adapt research outcomes into actionable solutions with agile methodologies.
  • Participate in agile development processes, working closely with firmware engineers, hardware teams, and Bell Labs researchers to align network services with broader platform goals.
  • Implement and uphold security protocols and best practices, ensuring network integrity, resilience, and minimal downtime in mission-critical applications.
